model.adapter_structure: inherit initial adapter_config exactly; r=8 alpha=16
model.loading_plan: PeftModel.from_pretrained(base, initial_adapter, is_trainable=True); same existing A/B tensors, base frozen

schedule_candidate.ordering: independent seeded task and SFT permutations each round
schedule_candidate.joint_step: one optimizer step after both loss gradients; no intermediate update

optimizer_candidate.scheduler: linear warmup then cosine decay to minimum
optimizer_candidate.rationale: Conservative continuation candidate for the existing SFT adapter; numerical/gradient smoke check before freezing, not a DEV-tuned optimum.
optimizer_candidate.schedule_unit: global joint optimizer update, continuous across all 5 rounds
optimizer_candidate.explicit_lr_convention: For update u=1..75: max_lr*u/4 for u<=4; min_lr+0.5*(max_lr-min_lr)*(1+cos(pi*(u-4)/71)) otherwise. Actual scheduler implementation must match this and be frozen after smoke.

loss_candidate.reward: official full task success=1, model failure=0; infrastructure failure is not a reward
loss_candidate.rl_reduction: mean over trajectories of mean over generated action tokens
loss_candidate.sft_reduction: sum target token CE / global target token count in this update
loss_candidate.rationale: lambda=1 and beta=0.01 are explicit starting candidates, not evidence of optimal balance; inspect each branch gradients and implementation before freezing.

online_sampling_candidate.behavior_logprobs: actual sampling policy, token support and transformations matched to trainer; save before update
online_sampling_candidate.context_limit_behavior: freeze explicit rollout termination/error semantics; no hidden history truncation

compute_candidate.resource_policy: Physical GPU1 only; GPU0 reserved for colleague, never auto-select another GPU
compute_candidate.serving_training_layout: GPU1 only, sequential serving/training/reference stages; measure feasibility in step 6
compute_candidate.sft_max_length: must support every selected full prefix and target; no length rejection
